[P2] Revisit the incompatible enum rename under rules 3 and 10

Existing configurations now return a different enum singleton, changing legacy `==` checks and breaking exhaustive switches over the old constants even when callers do not enable the new feature. The description acknowledges this incompatibility, but justifies the rename through JS #1296 and the new documentation names. Rule 10 explicitly rejects another SDK's design as justification, and rule 3 requires the Java API change's problem, cause, alternatives, and chosen rationale. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and evaluate the rename separately from async checkpointing, including preserving existing enum identities as a simpler direction.
